Delete the selfdestruct statement so calling sudicideAnyone no longer destroys the contract and sends its funds.
Replace the selfdestruct beneficiary with address(0) so the contract's balance is burned instead of sent to the caller.
Invert the access-check condition so that callers other than the owner may execute and the owner is blocked.
